findings.body: Raise: Functional. In a supported split-worker fallback, `building` is formatted for Claude at line 111. If Claude fails, the fallback selects Codex at line 211 and sets `on_codex = True` at line 235. This new callback then prints the stale Claude worker and model line when the Codex conversation starts, immediately after telling the user it fell back to Codex. The run gives contradictory status for the worker doing the work.
findings.title: Fallback reports Claude as the active worker after switching to Codex
